results.title: Suzuki Cycles
results.content:
Brea, CA (March 5, 2024) - Suzuki Motor USA, LLC (SMO) announces that Suzuki Manufacturing of America Corporation, (SMAC) has become a 100% subsidiary of SMO effective, March 1, 2024.  
   
 SMAC, founded in 2001 and based in Rome, Georgia, is Suzuki’s All-Terrain Vehicle (ATV) manufacturing facility. For over two decades, all Suzuki adult KingQuad ATVs have been manufactured at this location. Suzuki ATVs are sold in the United States, Canada, and nearly 25 countries worldwide. [...] A Suzuki KingQuad ATV being assembled at the company’s Rome, Georgia manufacturing plant. [...] Masami Haga, President of SMO, commented on the new structure. “One of the primary goals of this change is to expand our commitment to the growth of our entire powersports business. This evolution will also enable us to build on our relationships with Suzuki dealers and SMAC vendor partners.”  Haga noted that strengthening the supply chain and purchasing policies for locally sourced parts are objectives of the move as well.

The White House initially established 10% tariffs on imports from all countries, along with higher “reciprocal” tariffs targeting nations such as China, Vietnam and members of the European Union that levy tariffs on U.S. goods. [...] In 2024, the Peach State ranked seventh nationwide in net exports, shipping around $53.1 billion in locally made products overseas while importing about $145.6 billion, according to the Georgia Chamber of Commerce.

President Donald Trump’s newly unveiled tariffs have sent shockwaves through the manufacturing, technology and agricultural sectors across the country — particularly in Georgia.
